div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Data flow:
SET key ──> Hash table stores key->entry mapping
──> Entry added to LRU list head
──> Entry added to LFU bucket (freq=1)
──> Memory monitor checks limit
──> If full, policy selector chooses victim
──> Victim removed from all structures
